starting_balance.description: Stated opening escrow balance at the start of the computation year, in dollars. Required.

monthly_payments.description: Stated monthly escrow deposit values, one per month, at most 12 entries. Values only - never dates or identifiers.

disbursements.description: Stated monthly escrow disbursement values, one per month, at most 12 entries. Values only.

stated_balances.description: The servicer statement end-of-month balance values, one per month. Compared line by line against the recomputation.

stated_cushion.description: Optional: the servicer stated/target cushion amount. Checked against the one-sixth cap when supplied.

borrower_current.description: Optional: whether the borrower is current at analysis time. A refund-band surplus without it holds the audit for manual review.

monthly_escrow_payment.description: Optional: the borrower's monthly escrow payment in dollars, the base for the one-month shortage threshold. Defaults to the mean of monthly_payments.

servicer_chosen_course.description: Optional: the course the servicer chose: do_nothing, repay_within_30_days or repay_equal_monthly_12_plus_months. Reported as permitted or not.

rule.description: Rule id from the node's catalog, e.g. error_acknowledgment, loss_mit_evaluation, payoff_statement, arm_payment_change_notice.

trigger_date.description: Strict ISO YYYY-MM-DD event date that starts the clock. Required.

action_date.description: Optional: the date the servicer acted; without it the clock reports state within.

error_category.description: error_investigation only: one of the eleven enumerated error categories, 1-11.

request_type.description: info_request_response only: owner_identity (10 business days) or other (30).

foreclosure_sale_date.description: Optional sale date powering the 45-day and 37-day gates and the sale-bounded error window.

extension_notice_given.description: Written extension notice given before the deadline; adds 15 business days where the rule allows.

charge_date.description: Force-placed insurance: the date the premium charge is assessed.

initial_notice_date.description: Force-placed insurance reminder: the initial notice delivery date.

first_adjusted_payment_date.description: ARM notice windows: first payment due at the adjusted level.

consummation_date.description: arm_initial_adjustment_notice only: consummation date for the at-consummation case.

adjustment_frequency_days.description: ARM payment-change: uniformly scheduled adjustment interval in days; 60 or less selects the 25-day floor.

originated_before_2015_01_10.description: ARM payment-change pre-2015 short-index variant flag.

index_figure_lt_45_days.description: ARM payment-change pre-2015 variant: index figure less than 45 days old.

delinquency_date.description: foreclosure_referral_120day alias of trigger_date semantics: date the obligation went delinquent.

continuously_delinquent_since.description: no_duplicate_processing: borrower delinquent at all times since the prior complete application.

events.description: Event list, at most 32. Each event names a rule, a strict ISO trigger date, and rule-specific parameters.

name.description: EIP-712 domain field: the token/verifier's human-readable name. Mandatory, never defaulted.

version.description: EIP-712 domain field: the domain version string. Mandatory, never defaulted.

chainId.description: EIP-712 domain field: the chain id the signature was computed against. Mandatory, never defaulted.

verifyingContract.description: EIP-712 domain field: 20-byte hex address of the verifying contract. Mandatory, never defaulted or guessed.

digest.description: The 32-byte EIP-712 digest to recover a signer against (e.g. the art-590-x402-eip712-digest-recomputer output). Mandatory.

signature.description: Full signature hex: 64 bytes (r||s, recovery id supplied separately via v/yParity) or 65 bytes (r||s||v, recovery marker embedded). Alternative to r/s.

r.description: 32-byte hex signature r value. Used with s when signature is not supplied.

s.description: 32-byte hex signature s value. Used with r when signature is not supplied.

v.description: Recovery marker: raw bit (0/1), legacy Ethereum (27/28), or EIP-155 (chainId*2+35/36). EIP-155 form requires chainId.

yParity.description: Recovery marker as a raw bit (0/1). Takes precedence over v/embedded signature byte if supplied.

chainId.description: Required only when v is an EIP-155 value, to decode it back to the recovery bit.

claimedFrom.description: Optional 20-byte hex address to compare the recovered signer against. Omit for a standalone recovery-only call.

expected_chain_id.description: Mandatory policy parameter: the chain id the caller expects this authorization to be valid against. Never defaulted or inferred from the signed domain.

expected_verifying_contract.description: Mandatory policy parameter: the 20-byte hex verifying-contract address the caller expects. Never defaulted or inferred from the signed domain.

chainId.description: The chainId actually baked into the EIP-712 domain the signature was computed against.

verifyingContract.description: The verifyingContract actually baked into the EIP-712 domain the signature was computed against.

now_unix.description: Caller-supplied reference time (uint256 unix timestamp). This kernel never reads the system clock -- the check is a pure function of its inputs.

nonce_already_used.description: Optional: caller-computed boolean against the caller's own on-chain/off-chain record. This kernel never queries a chain.

total_supply.description: Vault totalSupply of shares as a non-negative uint256, decimal or 0x-hex string.

virtual_amounts.description: true (default) uses the OpenZeppelin virtual shares/assets mitigation: shares = assets * (totalSupply + 10**decimals_offset) / (totalAssets + 1). false uses the naive formula, which is the shape a first-depositor inflation attack drains.

decimals_offset.description: Virtual-shares decimals offset, integer 0..36 (default 0). Only meaningful when virtual_amounts is true; a larger offset bounds the inflation-attack loss more tightly.

operations.description: Conversions to recompute. Each entry is {op, amount}, where op is one of convertToShares, convertToAssets, previewDeposit, previewMint, previewWithdraw, previewRedeem. The rounding direction is not selectable: it is fixed per op by ERC-4626 and reported in the result.

round_trip_assets.description: Optional. Deposit this many assets then immediately redeem the shares minted, evaluated against the post-deposit state, to produce a round-trip loss bound in assets and basis points.

snapshot_b.description: Optional. A second {total_assets, total_supply} snapshot; the result carries the scaled share price of each and the signed drift in basis points between them.

fee_bps.description: Optional. Declared fee in basis points, integer 0..10000. ERC-4626 mandates no fee formula; this applies the OpenZeppelin ERC4626Fees shapes, rounding up.

fee_basis.description: 'raw' (fee charged on top of the amount) or 'total' (fee carved out of the amount). Default 'raw'.

network_label.description: Optional free-text network label, carried through verbatim. Never a selector.

request_id.description: Non-negative integer as a decimal or 0x-hex string, default '0'. Zero is the standard's aggregate convention, where the vault discriminates purely by controller and amounts across requests are fungible; a non-zero id is a discrete request that must stay at one pro-rata rate.

deposit.description: Deposit leg: {pending_assets, claimable_assets, claimable_shares}. The two claimable fields are a pair fixing the rate the vault made the request claimable at, so they must be both zero or both non-zero.

redeem.description: Redeem leg: {pending_shares, claimable_shares, claimable_assets}. Same pairing rule as the deposit leg.

claims.description: Claims to apply in order. Each entry is {leg, unit, amount}: leg is 'deposit' or 'redeem'; unit is 'requested' (deposit: assets, redeem: shares) or 'received' (deposit: shares, redeem: assets), matching the standard's four claim overloads.

claim_rounding.description: 'down' (default) or 'up'. ERC-7540 mandates NO direction for a partial claim, so one must be declared. Every claim reports what the other direction would have produced.

v.description: Recovery marker: raw bit (0/1) or legacy Ethereum (27/28). EIP-7702 authorization tuples natively carry yParity; v is accepted for callers who paste a v-style value by habit.

yParity.description: Recovery marker as a raw bit (0/1), the authorization tuple's native field name. Takes precedence over v/embedded signature byte if supplied.

charge_type.description: One of nine closed enum values: credit_insurance_premium, single_premium_credit_insurance_charge, debt_cancellation_fee, debt_suspension_fee, credit_related_ancillary_product_fee, finance_charge, application_fee, participation_fee, other_credit_card_fee. Mandatory. A value outside this set is outside the declared domain and outside the enumeration claim.

is_credit_card_account.description: True means consumer credit extended in a credit card account under an open-end, not home-secured, plan. That is the exact predicate 232.4(d)(1) opens on, and it is the only input that turns the bona fide fee exclusion on. Default false.

short_term_exception_claimed.description: True asserts reliance on the 232.4(c)(1)(iii)(B) short-term small amount loan carve-out. Semantically meaningful only for charge_type application_fee and a no-op for the other eight, though the enumeration still varies it across all nine so the coverage claim is not a filtered one. Default false.

loan_amount.description: Amount advanced at consummation, before any charge is deducted. Used with payment_amount, num_payments, odd_days and unit_period_days as a shorthand for a level payment schedule; ignored when advances and payments are supplied explicitly.

payment_amount.description: Regular periodic payment amount, for the shorthand schedule.

num_payments.description: Total number of scheduled payments, for the shorthand schedule.

periods_per_year.description: Unit periods per year, w in Appendix J. 12 = monthly, 26 = biweekly, 52 = weekly. Appendix J (b)(1) annualizes by multiplying the unit-period rate by this number, never by compounding it.

odd_days.description: Days from consummation to the start of the first full unit period. 0 = a regular schedule.

unit_period_days.description: Days in one unit period, 30 for a monthly unit period. Divides odd_days to give the Appendix J fraction f.

advances.description: Explicit advance flows, each {amount, full_periods, fraction} in the Appendix J form: an integer count of whole unit-periods plus a fraction in [0,1). Supplying advances and payments together overrides the shorthand fields.

payments.description: Explicit payment flows, same shape as advances.

mla_charges.description: Charges to classify under 32 CFR 232.4(c)(1) and (d). Each entry is {charge_type, amount, is_credit_card_account, short_term_exception_claimed}. charge_type is one of credit_insurance_premium, single_premium_credit_insurance_charge, debt_cancellation_fee, debt_suspension_fee, credit_related_ancillary_product_fee, finance_charge, application_fee, participation_fee, other_credit_card_fee. An unrecognised type is echoed, excluded from the arithmetic, and flagged for manual review rather than guessed at.

drawdowns.description: Array of drawdown flows. Each: {amount, full_periods, fraction} where full_periods is a whole count of years and fraction is a fraction of a year in [0,1) since the first drawdown (Annex III Part I's t_k), or the shorthand {amount, t_years}. At least one drawdown at t=0 is expected by Annex III Part I remark (b).

repayments.description: Array of repayment/charge flows, same {amount, full_periods, fraction} or {amount, t_years} shape as drawdowns (Annex III Part I's D_l/s_l).

annual_rate.description: Nominal annual rate, expressed as a decimal (0.12 = 12%). Required for calendar day-count conventions; optional when solve_rate is true and convention is UNIT_PERIOD.

convention.description: Closed set of seven day-count conventions (build spec Sec 1.1). An eighth mode is never accepted.

periods_per_year.description: Nominal periods per year (default 12). Used to derive UNIT_PERIOD's periodic rate from the annual rate; calendar conventions already express period_fraction as a fraction of a year and do not need it for that derivation.

periods.description: Ordered period descriptors, max 600 (MAX_PERIODS). Calendar conventions: {start, end, payment, is_termination?} with ISO dates. UNIT_PERIOD: {unit_fraction?, payment, is_termination?}, unit_fraction defaulting to 1 (a whole period); a stub is a declared fraction in (0,1].

solve_rate.description: If true and convention is UNIT_PERIOD, solves annual_rate by bracketed bisection against the periods[].payment stream instead of requiring a caller-supplied annual_rate. Not supported for calendar conventions (RATE_SOLVE_SCOPED_TO_UNIT_PERIOD).

apply_final_plug.description: Defaults to true. When true, rounding residue in the final period's closing_balance is absorbed into that period's principal_component, bounded by max_plug.

max_plug.description: Declared bound on the final-period plug (default 1, one currency unit). A residue exceeding this is reported as FINAL_PLUG_EXCEEDS_BOUND rather than silently applied.

remeasurement.description: Optional mid-stream remeasurement. {at_period_index, annual_rate?, convention?, periods_per_year?, periods}: the new segment opens at the prior segment's exact closing_balance at at_period_index.

fiscal_year_end.description: ISO calendar date YYYY-MM-DD. A real calendar date is required; 2023-02-30 is refused. Never a month/day pair.

filer_status.description: Closed enum. Anything outside it is refused, never coerced.

standard_id.description: Standard or ASU identifier, e.g. ASU-2023-07.

fiscal_year_begin.description: Optional ISO date. Supply it for a 52/53-week filer whose fiscal year start is not one year less one day before the year-end. When absent it is inferred and the inference is declared in fiscal_year_begin_basis.

registry_slice.description: The bounded registry slice to resolve against, delivered as data and never baked into the kernel. Shape: {registry_digest, entries}. registry_digest must equal sha256(canonical-JSON(slice minus registry_digest)) or resolution is refused. At most max_slice_entries=32 entries. Each entry is {standard_id, applies_to_filer_statuses, effective_for_annual_periods_beginning, effective_for_interim_periods_beginning, early_adoption_permitted, transition_method, parameter_set, citation}. Each entry must carry a citation {clause, source, source_digest, snapshot_location}; an entry with no digest is rejected, not warned about.

registry_digest.description: sha256 hex digest of the canonicalized slice (this field excluded from what is hashed).

entries.description: Bounded at 32 entries. Each parameter in an entry's parameter_set is an array of versions, each (value, effective_from, effective_to, source, source_digest), with non-overlapping half-open windows.

tree.description: The decision tree to evaluate, delivered as data (never baked into the kernel). Shape: {tree_id, tree_version, tree_digest, root, nodes}. Each node in `nodes` is {kind:'criterion', field, operator, operand, branches:{true, false}, citation} or {kind:'leaf', verdict, weight?, citation}. `tree_digest` must equal sha256(canonical-JSON(tree minus tree_digest)) or evaluation is refused. Every node must carry a non-empty citation {clause, source, source_digest, snapshot_location} or the tree is rejected by the loader.

tree_digest.description: sha256 hex digest of the canonicalized tree (this field excluded from what is hashed).

root.description: Node id of the root node.

nodes.description: Map of node id to node. Bounded: max_nodes=256, max_depth=12 root-to-leaf, max_tree_bytes=65536 (UTF-8 bytes of the whole tree object).

facts.description: Field values the tree's criteria are evaluated against. A criterion node whose declared `field` is absent from facts causes evaluation to refuse with FACT_FIELD_MISSING rather than silently branching.

segment_revenue_external.description: Candidate segment's revenue from external customers. Counts toward the 280-10-50-12(a) numerator.

segment_revenue_intersegment.description: Candidate segment's revenue from transactions with other operating segments. Counts toward the 280-10-50-12(a) numerator but never toward 280-10-50-14 coverage.

combined_revenue_all_reported_segments.description: 280-10-50-12(a) denominator: combined revenue, internal and external, of all reported operating segments. Caller-declared; never derived from the numerator.

segment_profit_or_loss.description: Candidate segment's reported profit or loss, signed. The absolute amount is taken for the 280-10-50-12(b) numerator, so a loss of -X classifies identically to a profit of +X.

combined_profit_of_profitable_segments.description: 280-10-50-12(b) denominator input (1): combined reported profit of all operating segments that did NOT report a loss.

combined_loss_of_loss_segments.description: 280-10-50-12(b) denominator input (2): combined reported loss of all operating segments that DID report a loss. The denominator is the greater of the two inputs in absolute amount, never the two netted together.

combined_assets_all_segments.description: 280-10-50-12(c) denominator: combined assets of all operating segments.

reportable_external_revenue.description: 280-10-50-14 numerator: cumulative EXTERNAL revenue of the reportable segments. Intersegment revenue is excluded here by the clause.

aggregation_similar_products_services.description: 280-10-50-11(a) nature of the products and services. Management judgment, echoed only. Null means unanswered, which is not false.

aggregation_similar_production_processes.description: 280-10-50-11(b) nature of the production processes. Management judgment, echoed only.

aggregation_similar_customer_type.description: 280-10-50-11(c) type or class of customer. Management judgment, echoed only.

aggregation_similar_distribution_methods.description: 280-10-50-11(d) methods used to distribute products or provide services. Management judgment, echoed only.

aggregation_similar_regulatory_environme.description: 280-10-50-11(e) nature of the regulatory environment, which the clause itself qualifies with 'if applicable'. Management judgment, echoed only.

reportable_segment_count.description: Optional count of reportable segments, used only for the non-binding practical-limit advisory that FASB Statement No. 131 paragraph 24 raises above ten.

included_in_segment_profit_measure.description: True means the expense is included in the reported measure of segment profit or loss. This is the gate ASC 280-10-50-26A opens on, and the only input whose false value places a candidate outside the significant expense principle. Default false.

regularly_provided_to_codm.description: True means the expense is regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker in the segment level information. First limb of ASC 280-10-50-26A. Also the input that decides ASC 280-10-50-26B(a) membership, and one of the two routes into an ASC 280-10-50-22 duty. Default false.

easily_computable_from_codm_information.description: True means the expense amount is easily computable from information regularly provided to the chief operating decision maker, for example cost of sales from a revenue amount and a gross margin amount. Second limb of ASC 280-10-50-26A, per ASC 280-10-55-15A and 55-15B. Disjunctive with regularly_provided_to_codm, never a substitute test. Default false.

assessed_significant.description: The entity's own ASC 280-10-50-26A significance judgment, weighing qualitative and quantitative factors. Caller declared. This node computes no benchmark because the Update states none, and the field is deliberately not named as a threshold for that reason. Default false.

specified_item_50_22.description: One of ten closed enum values: none, revenues_from_external_customers, intersegment_revenues, interest_revenue, interest_expense, depreciation_depletion_amortization, unusual_items, equity_in_net_income_of_equity_method_investees, income_tax_expense_or_benefit, significant_noncash_items_other_than_dda. These are the 9 live specified items of ASC 280-10-50-22, subparagraphs (a) through (j) with (i) superseded by ASU 2015-01, plus none. A value outside this set is echoed, flagged as outside the declared domain, and treated as none for disposition. Default none.

reconciling_item_category.description: One of nine closed enum values: state_and_local_income_tax_net_of_federal, foreign_tax_effects, effect_of_changes_in_tax_laws_or_rates_enacted_current_period, effect_of_cross_border_tax_laws, tax_credits, changes_in_valuation_allowances, nontaxable_or_nondeductible_items, changes_in_unrecognized_tax_benefits, other_not_listed. The first eight are the categories closed by ASC 740-10-50-12A(a); other_not_listed is the item within none of them that 740-10-50-12A(b)(3) addresses. A value outside this set is reported with category_recognized false and is outside the declared domain.

reconciling_item_amount.description: The SIGNED effect of one reconciling item, in reporting currency. Signed on input; the comparison takes its absolute value per BC35 of ASU 2023-09. Mandatory, finite.

pretax_income.description: Income or loss from CONTINUING OPERATIONS before income taxes, signed, in reporting currency. A negative value is a loss and is fully assessable, not degenerate, because the threshold base is taken in absolute amount. Mandatory, finite.

statutory_rate_pct.description: The applicable statutory federal or national income tax rate of the jurisdiction of domicile, expressed in percent, for example 21 for 21 percent. Caller declared and never derived by this node: per BC36 a foreign entity would normally use its own domicile rate, and an entity using any other rate must disclose that rate and its basis. Mandatory, finite, not negative.

entity_is_public_business_entity.description: True where the filer is a public business entity, which is the scope on which ASC 740-10-50-12A opens. False routes to ASC 740-10-50-13, a qualitative requirement over the same categories with no numerical reconciliation, so must_disclose_separately can never be true. Default false.

minimum_rate.description: The GloBE Minimum Rate as a decimal (0.15 = 15%), supplied as a versioned policy parameter. Never a kernel constant.

cutoff_date.description: Article 9.1.2 and 9.1.3 boundary date, YYYY-MM-DD. The comparison is strictly after, so an attribute arising on this date is not past the boundary.

transition_year_start_date.description: First day of the Transition Year for the jurisdiction, YYYY-MM-DD. Required to evaluate Article 9.1.3's window; its absence is a named error on any item declaring an intra group transfer.

exclusion_rules.description: The versioned exclusion set: named codes drawn from EXCL_NOT_REFLECTABLE_UNDER_AFAS, EXCL_CH3_ITEM_POST_CUTOFF, EXCL_GOVERNMENTAL_ARRANGEMENT_POST_CUTOFF, EXCL_RETROACTIVE_ELECTION_POST_CUTOFF and EXCL_NEW_CIT_BASIS_STEP_UP_POST_CUTOFF. A code outside this set is a named error.

application_order.description: Ordered, unique, non-empty list of bucket ids the note's own payment-application order declares (e.g. late_fee, escrow_shortage, escrow, interest, principal). A contract term -- never chosen or inferred by this tool.

bucket_balances.description: Map of bucket id -> pre-payment owed balance, in integer minor units (cents). Every bucket named in application_order must have an entry here.

payment_amount.description: The payment amount to allocate, in integer minor units (cents).

core_applied.description: Optional: the core's actual applied breakdown, bucket id -> integer minor units, to diff against the recomputed allocation. Omitted -> verdict INDETERMINATE.

as_of.description: Declared assessment date (YYYY-MM-DD). Never a runtime clock.

module.description: The pack's regime module selector; one pack, module as input.

id.description: Synthetic request identifier, unique within the list.

evidence_request_ids.description: Optional; arms stage 5 (binder-chain pointer set). Ids must match requests[].id.

sale_date.description: Declared sale date, ISO yyyy-mm-dd; an undated lot fails closed.

realized_loss.description: Declared realized loss on the lot; finite, non-negative.

replacement_purchases.description: Declared replacement purchases; may be empty. Each entry carries a date and an account_type; an undated entry fails closed.

account_type.description: Declared account type of the replacement purchase.

as_of.description: Optional as-of date, YYYY-MM-DD; optional; present on the well-formed fixture vectors, absent on some fail-closed ones, and validated as a date string by the kernel whenever present.

rules.description: The obligations register; a register must carry at least one obligation. Each entry must carry a rule_id; a missing or blank rule_id fails closed at intake.

owner.description: Non-empty string, or null marking an unassigned obligation; absent reads as unassigned.

control_ids.description: Absent or null reads as no controls, not as malformed.

evidence_refs.description: Absent or null reads as no evidence pointers, not as malformed.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the single currency this invoice is declared in; required.

invoice.description: The invoice under test: invoice_number, issue_date (YYYY-MM-DD), vendor_id, po_number, subtotal_minor, tax_minor, total_minor, and lines[] each carrying line, optional po_line, optional sku, qty (integer > 0), unit_price_minor, amount_minor.

purchase_order.description: The referenced purchase order: po_number and lines[] each carrying line, optional sku, qty (integer > 0), unit_price_minor. Optional; absence makes the run a no_po outcome.

goods_receipt.description: The goods receipt: receipt_id and lines[] each carrying po_line and qty_received (integer >= 0). Optional; absence downgrades the run to a two-way match reported per line as receipt_missing.

prior_invoices.description: Earlier invoices from the same vendor for duplicate screening: id, vendor_id, invoice_number, issue_date, total_minor, po_number. Optional.

duplicate_window_days.description: Day window for the within-window duplicate reason; |day difference| <= window counts as inside.

cash_minor.description: Starting cash in integer minor units; >= 0.

monthly_revenue_minor.description: Monthly revenue in month 1, integer minor units; >= 0.

monthly_burn_minor.description: Monthly burn before any burn cut, integer minor units; >= 0.

revenue_growth_bp.description: Month-over-month revenue growth in bp; integer, >= -10000.

goal.description: Goal: type runway_months | solvent_through_horizon | breakeven_by_month | ending_cash_at_least, plus integer value.

levers.description: Three sorted non-negative integer bp grids of at most 12 values: price_uplift_bp, growth_add_bp, burn_cut_bp.

effort_weights.description: Integer weight per lever; effort is the half-up sum of weight times lever over 100.

max_candidates.description: Maximum number of ranked candidates returned; integer >= 1.

mode.description: authorize evaluates the mandate and request; verify_commit re-verifies a presented authorization.

as_of.description: Decision time as a UTC timestamp, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS ending in Z. The node reads no clock.

ttl_seconds.description: authorize only: window seconds, clipped into 1 to 900 and to the mandate expiry.

mandate.description: authorize only: the mandate drawn on; commonly the canonical pivot from art-476.

extensions.description: authorize only, optional: revoked_at, budget minor integers, allowed_rails, verified_payees.

request.description: authorize: the proposed payment. verify_commit: the request being committed, as presented.

authorization.description: verify_commit only: the authorization this node issued, presented back for commit.

as_of.description: Pricing date, a real calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD. The node reads no clock; an entry applies when effective_from <= as_of <= effective_through.

usage.description: Requests per month, input and output tokens per request, cached-input and batch/long-context shares in bp, cache-write tokens with a 5m or 1h TTL.

requests_per_month.description: Non-negative integer at most 1e12: billable requests per month.

input_tokens_per_request.description: Non-negative integer input tokens per request; input tokens per month (times requests_per_month) must not exceed the 1e12 per-component cap.

cached_input_share_bp.description: Integer basis-point share of input tokens served from cache, 0..10000.

cache_write_tokens_per_request.description: Non-negative integer cache-write tokens per request; monthly cache-write tokens (times requests_per_month) must not exceed the 1e12 per-component cap.

output_tokens_per_request.description: Non-negative integer output tokens per request; output tokens per month (times requests_per_month) must not exceed the 1e12 per-component cap.

batch_share_bp.description: Integer basis-point share priced at batch rates, 0..10000; batch_share_bp plus long_context_share_bp must not exceed 10000.

long_context_share_bp.description: Integer basis-point share priced at long-context rates, 0..10000; batch_share_bp plus long_context_share_bp must not exceed 10000.

price_table.description: Dated snapshot: snapshot_verified_on, currency USD, unit usd_micros_per_million_tokens, and models[] with tier, effective dates and micros prices.

compare.description: Model names to price and rank, cheapest first; ties break by the model string.

notional.description: Total ladder notional, split across rungs pro rata to target_weight.

rungs.description: One object per rung: { maturity_years, coupon_rate_pct, yield_pct, target_weight }. Target weights must sum to 1 within 1e-9.

periods_per_year.description: Coupon periods per year for every rung (default 2).

reinvestment_assumption.description: Named in the output assumptions[]: hold coupons and maturing principal as cash at 0%, or reinvest them at the longest rung's yield.

benchmark_points.description: Caller-supplied benchmark points [{ tenor_years, yield_pct }]: at least 2, strictly increasing tenors, used exactly as given (no live data).

benchmark_name.description: Non-empty string naming the caller-supplied benchmark, echoed into the output curve.

interpolation.description: Named interpolation: 'linear' (linear@1) or 'monotone_cubic_hermite' (monotone_cubic_hermite@1, Fritsch-Carlson 1980). Defaults to linear.

bond.description: { maturity_years, yield_pct } of the bond. A maturity_years outside the benchmark tenor range is refused naming the range, never extrapolated.

tsv_id.description: Non-empty identifier of the venue being replayed; its volume is always included in the aggregate.

affiliated_tsv_ids.description: Identifiers of affiliated TSVs whose volume and symbols aggregate with the venue's. Never repeats tsv_id.

stocks.description: Declared universe [{ symbol, tier, prior_month_adv_shares }]. Tier is caller-declared ('tier_1'|'tier_2'); no LULD lookup.

prior_month_adv_shares.description: Positive integer prior-month ADV in shares, caller-declared. null reports the stock INDETERMINATE — never assumed.

daily_volume.description: One row per venue per day per symbol [{ date, tsv_id, symbol, shares }]; rows for the group are summed. Duplicates refused.

shares.description: Non-negative integer share count for that venue, day and symbol.

symbols_traded.description: Optional distinct-symbol record [{ date, tsv_id, symbol }]. When omitted, symbol days are derived from daily_volume.

prior_breaches.description: Volume breaches already recorded before the replayed window [{ symbol, date }]. Consumes the stock's one-time first-breach pass.

as_of_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date the pause status is evaluated as of.

hook_address.description: 0x-prefixed 40-hex-digit Uniswap v4 hook address; checksum not required, normalised to lowercase. Its low 14 bits are the permission bitmap.

declared_permissions.description: All 14 callback booleans, required, never defaulted; a missing key is refused. A Uniswap hooklist entry { hook, flags, properties } also accepted.

pool_fee.description: Optional uint24 pool fee; the fee is dynamic iff pool_fee & 0x800000 (8388608).

declaration_source.description: Optional free text naming where the declaration comes from, e.g. a registry entry or notice item; emitted unchanged in the output.

protocol_fee.description: uint24, both directions packed as v4 stores it: low 12 bits zeroForOne, bits 12-23 oneForZero; validated with isValidProtocolFee (each direction <= 1000 pips).

pool_fee.description: uint24: static LP fee in pips, or 0x800000 (8388608) for a dynamic-fee pool.

declared_lp_fee_bounds.description: { min_pips, max_pips }: the LP-fee band the declared story permits (0..1000000).

declared_total_fee_cap_pips.description: Optional total cap in pips; the composed swap fee plus the hook-charge rate is checked against it.

declared_hook_charge.description: { rate_pips, splits: [{ recipient_label, share_bps }] }: the separately declared hook charge; shares are reported as declared, never coerced.

swaps.description: Each swap: { index, zero_for_one, amount_in, emitted_fee_pips, lp_fee_override? (raw uint24 incl. the 0x400000 flag), exact_out? }.

stoppages.description: Caller-declared stoppages of the underlying NMS stock on the listing exchange; each { symbol, start_ts, end_ts|null, kind: halt | suspension | mwcb }.

tsv_trades.description: The TSV's tokenized-stock trades; each { symbol, ts, trade_id }.

tsv_halt_records.description: The TSV's own halt records; each { symbol, start_ts, end_ts|null }. Each stoppage must be spanned by one of them.

participant_notices.description: Participant notices; each { symbol, ts }. Latency is measured from stoppage start to the earliest notice at or after it.

concurrency_tolerance_ms.description: Optional non-negative integer (default 0), echoed. Widens the tolerated window around the interval edges.

bank_tier1_capital.description: Tier 1 capital in integer minor units, a positive multiple of 100, at most 1e12. The denominator of both thresholds.

group2_positions.description: Per-cryptoasset positions: cryptoasset name, optional holding_type (direct_cash, direct_derivative, indirect_fund, indirect_etn), and absolute long_exposure and short_exposure integers already delta-adjusted for derivatives.

program_name.description: Display name of the program; defaults to 'Unnamed Program' when blank.

program_type.description: WIOA Title I-B program type; selects the WIOA PY 2023 target set. Required.

program_year.description: Program year label; echoed in the report and used by the Apex page as a label only (the target set is not year-switched).

sector.description: Target sector key; selects the BLS QCEW Q3 2023 baseline annual wage. Required.

total_budget.description: Total program budget in USD; must be greater than 0. Required.

avg_training_weeks.description: Average training duration in weeks (1-104 on the Apex form); optional, display only.

participants_exited.description: Participants exited; must be >= 0. When omitted or null, defaults to participants_enrolled.

emp_rate_q2.description: Employment rate in the 2nd quarter after exit, percent (0-100); null when not applicable.

emp_rate_q4.description: Employment rate in the 4th quarter after exit, percent (0-100); null when not applicable.

median_earnings_q2.description: Median earnings in the 2nd quarter after exit, USD (>= 0); null when not entered.

credential_rate.description: Credential attainment rate, percent (0-100); null when not applicable.

skill_gains_rate.description: Measurable skill gains rate, percent (0-100); null when not applicable.

net_se_income.description: Net self-employment income in dollars for the year. Default 150000 when absent.

reasonable_salary_pct.description: Reasonable W-2 salary as a percent of net SE income, 0-100; the compute divides by 100. Default 50.

annual_admin_cost.description: Annual S-Corp accounting and payroll admin cost in dollars. Typical band $1,500-$3,000/yr; outside values honored and flagged. Default 3000.

owner_health_premium_annual.description: Owner health premium, annual dollars. Echoed, unused by the compute (DIFFERS D2). Default 0.

filing_status.description: Filing status. Excluded from the tax math (DIFFERS D1); selects only the section 199A threshold caveat flag. Default single.

older_transfer_fee.description: Schedule used before the switch epoch: { epoch, maximum_fee, transfer_fee_basis_points }, all decimal strings (u64; basis points u16).

newer_transfer_fee.description: Schedule used from its epoch on: { epoch, maximum_fee, transfer_fee_basis_points }, all decimal strings. Applies when execution_epoch >= this epoch.

amount.description: The TransferChecked amount, i.e. pre-fee, in base units. Decimal string in u64 range.

execution_epoch.description: The Clock epoch in which the transfer executes. Decimal string in u64 range.

instruction.description: The checked transfer instruction. Unchecked transfers are refused: they fail with MintRequiredForTransfer on a mint carrying the fee extension.

declared_fee.description: TransferCheckedWithFee only: the fee the instruction states. A mismatch is recorded as FeeMismatch.

credited_amount.description: What the payment verifier credited, in base units. Decimal string in u64 range.

verifier_epoch.description: Optional: the epoch the verifier used for its fee. A different schedule pick than the execution epoch emits EPOCH_SCHEDULE_DIVERGENCE.

required_amount.description: Optional: the payee's required amount, for the informational x402 consumer view (gross-accept static path vs net-accept balance-delta path).

first_notice_date.description: Date the written first notice was delivered or mailed. Required.

reminder_notice_date.description: Date the reminder notice was delivered or mailed. Required.

charge_date.description: Date the force-placed premium charge was assessed. Required.

charged_premium_amount.description: Premium charge assessed for the coverage period. Required, non-negative.

charge_coverage_start.description: Start of the period the charged premium covers. Required.

charge_coverage_end.description: End of the period the charged premium covers. Required, not before the start.

alternative_quote_amount.description: Optional borrower-provided alternative-quote premium for the values-only benchmark table; the benchmark refuses when it is missing.

evidence_of_continuous_coverage_date.description: Optional date evidence of continuous compliant coverage was received; triggers the 15-day cancel-and-refund evaluation.

borrower_coverage_start.description: Start of the borrower’s own hazard coverage period; required to compute the pro-rata refund when evidence is present.

borrower_coverage_end.description: End of the borrower’s own hazard coverage period.

cancellation_date.description: Optional date the force-placed coverage was cancelled.

refund_date.description: Optional date the refund was sent.

notice_mail_class.description: Optional mail class enum: first_class, certified, registered, priority_express, other. Only a class not less than first-class satisfies the mailing rule.

first_notice_content_items.description: Optional JSON array of content-item keys present on the first notice (c2_i through c2_xi); when supplied, all eleven items are required.

soc_code.description: 6-digit SOC code key into the embedded 62-row table; null selects the custom-occupation estimate branch (Apex L480-488). Optional: only this input is conditionally dereferenced.

rc.description: Routine Cognitive share 0..100 (slider t_rc, Apex L470; parseInt read).

rm.description: Routine Manual share 0..100 (slider t_rm, Apex L471; parseInt read).

nra.description: Non-routine Analytical share 0..100 (slider t_nra, Apex L472; parseInt read).

nri.description: Non-routine Interpersonal share 0..100 (slider t_nri, Apex L473; parseInt read).

nrm.description: Non-routine Manual share 0..100 (slider t_nrm, Apex L474; parseInt read).

sector_exp.description: Sector exposure factor (select sector, Apex L475; parseFloat read). Apex option values 0.22..0.75.

ed_level.description: Highest education (select edLevel, Apex L476; informational education adjustment only, Apex L499-500).

years_role.description: Years in role (input yearsRole, Apex L477; parseInt read; recorded, not in the arithmetic).
